## Procedure and coverage

Before the flash, free-space, op, hook, boot and update-path checks passed, and the peaking code ran in a harness with the late segments not copied. The owner then ran a test sheet that included starts after 2 minutes off and with the battery out.

- The label, MF peaking lines, MF Assist, no peaking in S-AF, and spot metering by touch worked.
- The debug log shows cold starts and starts with RAM kept that end normally.

## Limits and assumptions

- The owner's bodies never showed the slow start, so the start time on an affected body is not confirmed with this build.
- A contributor's own build of the same change started at once on an affected body; that build is not published.
- One owner; not reproduced by the Atlas.
